content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication: recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that persisted despite initial evaluation. The clinical indication note identifies a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency and states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmic activity. The denial cites missing prior authorization under CO-197; we request reconsideration based on this documented indication."}
